actual_persisted_item.brief: Across the combined 24-case cohort for plan_r0001_c02, magnitude classification collapsed to a single class: all 14 positive predictions were '2-3x', with zero '3-10x' and zero '10x+' predictions, while the truth distribution contained 5 '3-10x' and 2 '10x+' cases. The magnitude confusion matrix shows 6 underestimates, 0 overestimates, and 4 correct magnitude calls, yielding magnitude_accuracy 0.2857 and magnitude_macro_f1 0.1569.
actual_persisted_item.detail: The runtime magnitude_diagnostics for plan_r0001_c02 (population research_completed, 24 cases, 0 technical exclusions) records prediction_distribution.predicted_2-3x = 14, predicted_3-10x = 0, predicted_10x+ = 0. Truth distribution: 2-3x = 7, 3-10x = 5, 10x+ = 2, non_surge = 10. The confusion matrix shows every true 3-10x case (5) and every true 10x+ case (2) predicted as 2-3x, plus 4 non_surge cases predicted 2-3x. underestimate_count = 6, overestimate_count = 0, magnitude_correct_count = 4, conditional_accuracy_on_tp = 0.4. The per-case magnitude_feedback error kinds confirm the pattern: cases 13, 14, 15, 23 are 'underestimate' with ordinal_distance 1 (2-3x predicted vs 3-10x true), and cases 16 and 24 are 'underestimate' with ordinal_distance 2 (2-3x predicted vs 10x+ true). No case shows an overestimate. This is a magnitude-class failure concentrated in the upper classes, not a binary-direction failure: binary_f1 is 0.7143 with 10 TP, 4 FP, 4 FN, 6 TN. The binary tradeoff is roughly symmetric (4 FP vs 4 FN), so the magnitude collapse is not explained by a directional bias toward negative calls.
limitations: The magnitude_diagnostics matrix is deterministic descriptive feedback on frozen cases; it does not establish why the classifier concentrated on 2-3x.

The 2-3x class has the largest support (7 true cases), so a majority-class default would mechanically produce many 2-3x predictions; the diagnostics alone cannot separate a default heuristic from a genuine evidence-based choice.
Magnitude macro-F1 is the confirmed secondary ordering only at exactly equal Combined Binary F1; it does not override binary F1 as primary fitness.
The realized magnitude classes are maximum five-complete-trading-day adjusted-close mean multiples within the horizon, not sustained price levels.

actual_persisted_item.brief: Add a magnitude-class support check that reports per-class support and conditional accuracy on true positives before finalizing any magnitude band, because both Plans show low conditional_accuracy_on_tp (0.444 and 0.40) with thin per-class support.
actual_persisted_item.detail: plan_r0001_c01 magnitude_diagnostics: conditional_accuracy_on_tp=0.4444, tp_denominator=9, per_class_support 10x+=2, 2-3x=7, 3-10x=4. plan_r0001_c02: conditional_accuracy_on_tp=0.40, tp_denominator=10, per_class_support 10x+=2, 2-3x=7, 3-10x=5. The 10x+ class has only 2 supporting cases in each Plan, so any magnitude band above 3-10x is support-poor. Action: require the reflection skill to report per-class support and conditional accuracy on true positives alongside any magnitude band choice, and to flag support-poor classes explicitly rather than silently defaulting to the lowest positive band.
limitations: Per-class support is computed on the research_completed population, which excludes technical cases.
The 10x+ class has only 2 supporting cases per Plan, so any conclusion about that class is support-poor and should not be treated as robust.
This action does not require a quantified valuation bridge or guaranteed price path as a condition for a positive judgment.
